sections.heading: Sofia Vergara — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sofia Vergara was born on 10 July 1972 in Barranquilla, and holds Colombian and American nationality. She was given the name Sofía Margarita Vergara Vergara at birth and is publicly known as Sofia Vergara.
Public records name her father, Julio Enrique Vergara Robayo. She is a sibling of Sandra Vergara and Veronica Vergara.
She received her education at Marymount International School Barranquilla and National University of Colombia.
She is recorded as speaking Spanish and English.
